note: No authorized first-party report or real campaign dataset has been supplied. Empty means unavailable, not zero traffic or zero orders. Browser counters are not Amazon eligible Sessions or purchase reports. Keep original/normalized exports and populated ledgers private; this public file is an empty contract, not an invitation to commit personal or account data.

required_fields.campaign_key: Static predeclared campaign label, only if actually present in the authorized mapping; never derived from a person. Blank if an export only identifies the tracking ID.
required_fields.period_start: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD reported period start; never inferred from a click timestamp.
required_fields.timestamp_utc: UTC time the authorized normalized report was imported; not a fabricated purchase timestamp.
required_fields.source: Official report URL and private original-export reference, without credentials or query tokens.
required_fields.channel: Static channel such as organic, only when the evidence/mapping establishes it; no user identifier.
required_fields.eligible_sessions: Non-negative integer only when expressly reported; otherwise null. Never copied from browser loads or clicks.
required_fields.clicks: Non-negative integer from the authorized report; null if unavailable, distinct from this site's raw outbound counter.
required_fields.reported_orders: Non-negative order count only if reported as orders; never substitute ordered items or infer orders from clicks. Null when unavailable.
required_fields.normalized_sha256: SHA-256 of the normalized imported file; retain original/mapping privately. A hash identifies a file, not proof of Amazon authorship.
required_fields.row_provenance: Private original/normalized row mapping and explicit authorization assertion. The assertion is not an authentication of Amazon.

implementation: tools/analytics_server.py imports only normalized authorized aggregate reports into a private SQLite database and records source URL, static channel, period, row number, SHA-256 and UTC import time. It does not sum overlapping exports or derive a conversion rate. See docs/MEASUREMENT.md.
